question: How long does airport transfer take?
answer: Transfer times vary depending on your destination. From Nairobi Jomo Kenyatta International Airport to central Nairobi is typically 30-45 minutes. Transfers to lodges outside the city can take 2-5 hours depending on distance. We provide accurate time estimates when booking and track flight arrivals to ensure timely pickups. Our drivers are professional, courteous, and knowledgeable about the region.
